description.en: Calcified fertile whorls form joined disc-to-funnel structures around an axis.
description.zh: 钙化育性轮在轴周形成相连的盘至漏斗状结构。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Clypeina marginoporella, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Clypeina marginoporella 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Projecting whorl discs and hollow centers differ from Diplopora's continuous cylindrical shell.
distinctness.zh: 外突轮盘及中空中央区别于Diplopora连续筒壳。

modeling_brief.en: Use one documented connected pair of whorls with coarse radial divisions; do not extrapolate a tall unknown stalk.
modeling_brief.zh: 使用一对有记录的相连轮盘及粗放射分区，不外推未知高轴。

uncertainty: Eocene type-genus concept; Jurassic Clypeina sulcata belongs to a revised genus and is not silently included.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
